name: Staged Equilibration at Physiological Conditions (310 K)
description: Nine-stage equilibration at 310 K for solvated metalloprotein/cofactor systems: SD+CG minimize, single 0->310 K heat, CPU NPT-density / GPU NPT-relax handoff, graduated solute restraint release (25->10->5->2->0), and unrestrained NPT production. A heavy-atom restraint mask protects structural metals, cofactors, and modeled loops on fresh builds. Stage 3 (NPT density) must run on CPU to dodge the pmemd.cuda fixed-PME-grid limitation while the box shrinks; assign it a CPU resource class in your run plan.
author: Matthew J. Guberman-Pfeffer

steps.name: Staged Minimization
steps.description: SD+CG energy minimization with heavy-atom solute restrained at 50 kcal/mol*A^2. Relaxes solvent, hydrogens, and mobile ions around a held solute. Engine: CPU (pmemd.MPI).

steps.name: Heating (0 to 310 K)
steps.description: Single NVT heating ramp from 0 to 310 K over 300 ps then hold, solute restrained at 25 kcal/mol*A^2, 1 fs step. Engine: GPU (pmemd.cuda).

steps.name: NPT Density (CPU phase)
steps.description: Short NPT to converge box density at 310 K, solute restrained at 25 kcal/mol*A^2, Berendsen barostat, 1 fs step. MUST run on CPU (pmemd.MPI): the box shrinks here and pmemd.cuda cannot reallocate its PME grid mid-run.

steps.name: NPT Relaxation (GPU phase)
steps.description: Longer NPT at 310 K once density has converged, solute restrained at 25 kcal/mol*A^2, Berendsen barostat, 1 fs step. Box is stable so the fixed pmemd.cuda PME grid is safe. Engine: GPU (pmemd.cuda).

steps.name: Restraint Release (10 kcal)
steps.description: NPT at 310 K with solute restraints tapered to 10 kcal/mol*A^2 for 500 ps, Berendsen barostat, 1 fs step. Engine: GPU (pmemd.cuda).

steps.name: Restraint Release (5 kcal)
steps.description: NPT at 310 K with solute restraints tapered to 5 kcal/mol*A^2 for 500 ps, Berendsen barostat, 1 fs step. Engine: GPU (pmemd.cuda).

steps.name: Restraint Release (2 kcal)
steps.description: NPT at 310 K with solute restraints tapered to 2 kcal/mol*A^2 for 500 ps, Berendsen barostat, 1 fs step. Last restrained stage. Engine: GPU (pmemd.cuda).

steps.name: Unrestrained Settle
steps.description: Fully released NPT settle at 310 K for 1 ns, no restraints, Berendsen barostat, 2 fs step. Engine: GPU (pmemd.cuda).

steps.name: Production MD (50 ns)
steps.description: Unrestrained production at 310 K and 1 atm, Monte Carlo barostat, low-friction Langevin (gamma=1), 2 fs step, 50 ns (restart-extendable). Engine: GPU (pmemd.cuda).
